record.name: Escrowed maker quotes
record.summary: Trade a complete signed quote against its maker’s funded inventory, with exact amounts and single-use cancellation.

units.amounts: Raw currency/token units; no display/value conversion
units.liquidity: Actual core L, not token balances or economic value
units.time: Absolute UTC seconds; inclusive starts and exclusive sale/commit/reveal ends
units.identity: Maker/holder/bidder/router identity is exactly the source-defined account, not inferred human diversity

fields.name: currency0
fields.label: Currency0
fields.help: The lower address in the actual ordered plain ERC20 pair.

fields.name: currency1
fields.label: Currency1
fields.help: The higher address in the actual ordered plain ERC20 pair.

fields.name: sqrtPriceX96
fields.label: Initial pool sqrt price
fields.units: Q64.96 sqrt(raw currency1/currency0); not a display-token price
fields.help: Review both token decimals and initial pool price. Opening/auction prices do not set or move this AMM price.

liveChecks.requirement: Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code, raw decimals and exact debit/credit behavior. Native, tax, rebase, restricted and dishonest assets are unsupported.
Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code, raw decimals and exact debit/credit behavior. Native, tax, rebase, restricted and dishonest assets are unsupported.

The actual callback router must match the maker’s EIP712 quote and settle the exact signed input/output pair. Review taker funding and ultimate delivery separately: maker consent is not taker identity or payment authority.

Before filling, check actual maker inventory/Manager-claim backing, unordered nonce bitmap, current chain/hook/manager/pool/currencies, inclusive validAfter/exclusive expiry and the maker’s current EOA or bounded static ERC1271 policy. A valid quote reserves no liquidity; makers can withdraw or cancel.

Require canonical abi.encode(RfqQuote,bytes), at most 1536 bytes and signature at most 1024 bytes; EOA signatures are 65-byte low-S/v27/28, ERC1271 static check uses 50,000 gas with canonical 32-byte magic. Exact-in/out must match the entire signed pair and direction-canonical core sqrt limits; no partial AMM fallback.

definition.help: Each maker owns a separate actual funded Manager-claim escrow. Only that maker can withdraw, paid to itself; contract-maker signers are not automatically the asset recipient. Quotes fill wholly in either exact mode/direction and consume one unordered nonce. Custom fills fully skip the AMM, so the pool LP fee is zero and no core LP/protocol fee is generated. Separate terminal/router charges are not part of the signed pair. Uncredited donations create no maker rights; failed final settlement rolls back inventory, claims and nonce. Large inventories withdraw in bounded chunks. No fair-price, wallet-uniqueness or PQ-equivalence claim.
